speaker: Jeff Geerling
context: Public reply in the Hacker News discussion of HomelabFest, following questions about whether queer people would be welcome.
excerpt: No matter who you are or where you come from.
summary: Geerling referred to the age notice on older posts, described some Reddit users as interested only in proving they were righteous and he was evil, used the saying “Never wrestle with a pig: You both get dirty and the pig likes it.” He then said he now ignores those threads. He also said HomelabFest aims to bring the community together and is for everyone.
what_it_addresses: This is a public statement of broad welcome and directly answers that people of any background are intended to be included.
what_remains_unclear: The reply does not identify which positions in the older posts he still holds or how his views on those issues have changed.
